error.invalidCredentials: The username, email address or password is wrong. Try again, or choose “Lost your password?”.
error.unauthorized: You are not logged in, or your session has expired. Log in again.
error.mfaRequired: You need to confirm with two-factor authentication before you continue. Log in again.
error.forbidden: The action was refused. The page may have been open too long: reload it and try again.
error.invalidPassword: The password is wrong. Try again.
error.passwordRequired: Enter your password to confirm the change.
error.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Check the code in your authenticator app and try again.
error.registrationClosed: Registration is turned off on this site.
error.registrationUnavailable: Registration is unavailable for the moment. Try again later, or contact the administrator.
error.invalidToken: The link is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new link.
error.weakPassword: The password cannot be the same as the username or the email address. Choose another password.
error.sameEmail: This is already your email address.
error.emailUnavailable: This email address cannot be used. Try another one.
error.originInvalid: The request was refused because it came from another address. Open the page again from the address you usually use.
error.setupTokenRequired: The setup code is missing. Paste it and try again.
error.invalidSetupToken: The setup code does not match. Copy it again from the log of the api service, or make a new one with “toa core setup-token”.
error.alreadyInstalled: The site is already installed. Go to the login screen.
error.stepMissing: One of the previous steps has not been saved. Go back and finish it.
error.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another.
error.emailTaken: Another account uses that email address. Enter a different one.
error.contentExists: The database already holds content the installation would have made. Nothing was changed. Contact whoever runs the site.
error.recoveryKeyMismatch: The recovery key on the screen is not the latest one made. Make a new key, save it and try again.
error.validation: Something in the form is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
error.tooManyFactors: The account already has as many authenticator apps as it can have. Remove one of them first.
error.mfaRequiredByRole: Your role requires two-factor authentication, so the last app cannot be removed. Set up a new app first.
error.noFactor: The account has no two-factor authentication, so there are no recovery codes to make. Set up an app first.
error.mfaFinished: The two-factor step is already done or has expired. Log in again.
error.enrolmentUnreadable: The stored key could not be read. Start the setup again.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.tooManyRequestsIn: Too many attempts. Try again in {wait}.
error.network: Cannot reach the service. Check your connection and try again. What you filled in has been kept.
error.server: Something went wrong on our side. What you filled in has been kept. Try again in a little while.
error.serverWithReference: Something went wrong on our side. What you filled in has been kept. Try again in a little while, and give the reference {id} if it goes on.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
error.formRejected: The form was not sent. Reload the page, wait a moment and try again.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.text: The address is wrong, or the page has been moved or removed. Go to the front page and find it from there.

failed.heading: The page could not be shown
failed.text: Something went wrong on our side while showing the page. Try again in a little while.
